description: Regions of the Simulation Window (/simulation) and the atlas labels each one is built from. Read by build_sim_anatomy.py, which writes the meshes (public/sim/anatomy.bin.gz) and the label map (public/sim/regions.nii.gz). Region centroids, hemisphere centroids and volumes are not stored anywhere: the page computes them from the label map when it loads. Regions with "simulated": false are shown and measured (depth, placement) but are not nodes of the oscillator network in src/lib/sim/neural.ts, which has no coupling data for them, so they cannot be stimulation targets.

schaefer2018.labels: Parcel names from CBIG's Schaefer2018_400Parcels_17Networks_order.txt, matched by network and anatomical tag (e.g. VisPeri_StriCal matches 17Networks_LH_VisPeri_StriCal_1)
schaefer2018.licence: MIT (Computational Brain Imaging Group) — see public/sim/NOTICE.md

regions.name: Primary visual cortex (V1)
regions.rationale: The parcels Schaefer labels striate (calcarine) cortex, which is V1 by definition.
regions.replaces: Harvard-Oxford intracalcarine + supracalcarine cortex + occipital pole

regions.name: Dorsolateral PFC
regions.rationale: Lateral and dorsal prefrontal parcels of the frontoparietal control networks; the closest overlap with the middle frontal gyrus of the parcel groups tried.

regions.name: Ventromedial PFC
regions.rationale: Medial orbitofrontal (limbic B) and medial prefrontal (default A) parcels. Schaefer has no vmPFC parcel; together these cover medial OFC, subgenual and pregenual cortex, and also reach into dorsomedial PFC.

regions.name: Insula
regions.rationale: Every parcel Schaefer labels insular, across the three networks that reach the insula.

regions.name: Auditory cortex
regions.rationale: The parcels Schaefer labels auditory. They cover Heschl's gyrus and the surrounding superior temporal cortex, so the region is larger than primary auditory cortex.

regions.name: Sensorimotor cortex (M1/S1)
regions.rationale: Schaefer's somatomotor parcels around the central sulcus. Network parcels do not separate precentral (M1) from postcentral (S1) cortex, so the region is named for both.

regions.name: Putamen
regions.rationale: The aseg putamen labels. 14 of their voxels are also Schaefer insula; the insula keeps them.

regions.name: Nucleus accumbens
regions.rationale: The aseg accumbens labels. 14 of their voxels are also Schaefer vmPFC; the vmPFC keeps them.

regions.name: Lateral geniculate nucleus
regions.rationale: MASSP's lateral geniculate labels. 15 of their voxels are also aseg hippocampus; the hippocampus keeps them.

regions.name: Dorsal extrastriate visual cortex
regions.rationale: Schaefer's superior extrastriate parcels, above the calcarine sulcus: on Harvard-Oxford (used only to check), 38 % cuneus, 15 % superior lateral occipital, 13 % occipital pole, 10 % precuneus. Network parcels do not follow retinotopic borders, so V3d is inside this region but not separated from V2d and V3A.

regions.name: Ventral extrastriate visual cortex
regions.rationale: Schaefer's inferior extrastriate parcels, below the calcarine sulcus: on Harvard-Oxford (used only to check), 80 % lingual gyrus, 11 % temporal-occipital fusiform. This is mostly ventral V2/V3 territory; hV4 on the posterior fusiform gyrus is only partly inside. 33 of its voxels are also aseg hippocampus; the hippocampus keeps them.

regions.name: Inferior frontal gyrus (incl. Broca's area)
regions.rationale: The Schaefer parcel groups with the best overlap (Dice 0.45) with Harvard-Oxford's IFG pars triangularis + opercularis, of every combination of the ventrolateral frontal groups. On Harvard-Oxford (used only to check): 33 % pars triangularis + opercularis, 22 % frontal orbital (which holds pars orbitalis), 16 % frontal pole, 9 % central operculum. Areas 44 and 45 cannot be told apart in Schaefer, so they are one region.

regions.name: Anterior supramarginal gyrus
regions.rationale: The Schaefer parcel group with the best overlap (Dice 0.39) with Harvard-Oxford's anterior supramarginal gyrus, where PFt lies, of every combination of the inferior parietal groups. On Harvard-Oxford (used only to check): 37 % anterior and 14 % posterior supramarginal gyrus, 28 % parietal operculum.
